answer_sql:
SELECT
  c.country_name,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_key) AS customers,
  SUM(s.net_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_key) AS revenue_per_customer
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON s.sale_country_code = c.country_code
WHERE
  c.is_placeholder = FALSE
GROUP BY
  c.country_name
ORDER BY
  revenue_per_customer DESC
